blocks.text: Try telling Filipinos to pay their taxes right now. The economy grew by a dismal 2.1% in the third quarter of 2026. Billions of pesos in flood control funds are the subject of corruption investigations. And the government wants more of our hard-earned money. Against that backdrop, who in his right mind would want to be a tax collector in this country? And yet, the Bureau of Internal Revenue (BIR) collected P2.814 trillion in gross revenues from January to October, P149.86 billion more than it did during the same period last year.
